name: Puppies
description: This litter of puppies are little cuties who were brought into the rescue after their mum passed away. We have been caring for them since and they are all thriving and doing really well. There are two females and three males in the litter – please mention on your application form if you have a gender preference.They are currently 6 weeks old so we are starting the search for their forever homes, ready for when they are old enough to leave us.As with all of our dogs we will be selecting the most suitable homes for them so please include plenty of detail on your application form – we will be in contact with suitable applicants – please don’t call the rescue to chase up your application as we need to keep our phone lines free.Puppies can be hard work and are a 10+ year commitment so please ensure you have put a lot of thought into applying for them before sending in the form and please do not apply if you have holidays booked in the next few weeks which will cause a delay of them being able to go home. They will likely be ready to leave from around the 19th of August.

Mum was a black Labrador and dad is a Lurcher cross Greyhound, so they will likely be around medium sized when fully grown. They will be active dogs who will require daily exercise and mental stimulation to keep them satisfied.Due to their young age they can be rehomed with compatible friendly dogs (must be neutered if the opposite gender), other animals and dog-savvy children aged 5+ in their next home. They are typical puppies who are very lively, greedy and playful! They are into everything and are quite confident puppies.

These puppies are looking for homes with owners who have plenty of time + energy to put into their ongoing training and socialisation whilst they grow to ensure they mature into well-rounded adults. They will thrive in homes with owners who have active lifestyles and will benefit from puppy classes.

name: Enzo
description: Enzo is an extremely handsome boy, who is sadly looking for his new home due to his owners work commitments. This has been an extremely difficult decision, but it is what’s best for Enzo’s future.
He is staying in his current home to keep him out of kennels, so please bare this in mind that he is not at the rescue on a daily basis.

He is a super friendly lad, who is happy to greet everyone and make friends along the way.He loves nothing more than to go to his favourite place down at the beach and dive into the waves and push his nose into the rock pools in hope something fun may jump out at him.
Enzo has had a lot of training done with him and is looking for people to put time into continuing this.

As you can imagine, he is a big lad, so has a good amount of strength behind him, so potential owners need to keep this in mind. He isn’t an easy plod along boy, and does want to get out and about going for long walks and up in the mountains to have some good adventures like he does currently.He loves to learn new things and will do anything for some tasty chicken or ham, so maybe he could start learning to surf, so he can enjoy his favourite place even more.

Since a puppy, he has been well socialised with dogs, he will voice his presence to begin with and can be quite intimidating, which some dogs aren’t keen on. It is all frustration when he is held back on lead, and as soon as he has had a sniff of them he settles down quickly and generally ignores them.We feel he would be best suited as the only dog, so his social skills on lead can be worked on and learn to settle down when he’s out and about. He would really love to be with confident owners that will keep him well socialised with dogs and make new doggy friends from positive interactions, so he can eventually be running free with them which he has learnt to do in his current home.
Enzo has lived with very young children and apart from the odd knocking over due to his size, he has been great with them, so is looking for a home with children aged 5+.
He is such a loveable young lad, who we know will make someone a big cuddly companion and please bare with us to make arrangements for Enzo to be brought to NCAR for any visits with new adopters.
